Summary: According to the provided sources, DRAGIN (Dynamic Retrieval Augmented Generation based on the Information Needs of Large Language Models) achieved superior performance across four benchmark datasets: 2WikiMultihopQA, HotpotQA, StrategyQA, and IIRC. Specifically, DRAGIN outperformed baselines like FLARE and FS-RAG in terms of Exact Match (EM) and F1 scores on all datasets. For instance, on the StrategyQA dataset, DRAGIN achieved an EM of 0.314 and an F1 score of 0.4238, compared to 0.180 and 0.2756 for FLARE. The sources also provide hyperparameters for different LLMs, such as the generate length and θθ values for models like Llama2-13b-chat and Vicuna-13b-v1.5.
